messages:
Marta (Design): Uploaded a compact comp for frame annotations. Two quick asks: should the pill be an overlay in the gutter or inline in each row? Also proposal for export: include annotations inline by default, with toggle to export as separate file. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/example

Sam (Eng): Overlay in gutter preferred for dense traces. Implementation note: keep DOM order (frame text then button) so screen readers and keyboard nav stay logical. We'll add export flag include_annotations=true and version the JSON export.

Nina (A11y): Agreed on DOM order. For SR: announce a short summary when frame gains focus ("Annotation: likely null header"). Provide a separate "Details" control for metadata to avoid dumping long strings on focus. Use aria-label="Annotation for <function> 0: Edit".

Alex (Product): For exports, default inline keeps context for sharing; add helper copy: "Include annotations (visible in trace)" and note "Personal annotations excluded by default." Also attach author + timestamp in export_v2.

Marta (Design): Copy decision: label the UI "Annotation" and surface a type selector inside the editor (hypothesis/observation/action). Action items: Ryan update figma to show gutter overlay; Sam prototype export_v2; Nina draft SR strings; Alex finalize export modal copy.

Sam (Eng): Starting branch for export schema. Will include sample JSON and opt-in separate-file option.

Nina (A11y): I'll add keyboard shortcut notes and a small SR announcement spec.

Marta (Design): Thanks team 1: unless objections I'll land "Annotation (type: hypothesis)" for the pill label and inline-export default by EOD.
